name: Legend of the Silver Fox
source: Elenor loved the stories her father used to tell her. Especially the one about the Silver Fox. However, this was not a story. She knew it was true; the mysterious animal existed! In order to prove that her father was right all along she searches the Silver Fox herself. Together with her best friend, Jack who lives at the dairy, she keeps exploring the forest. One day, however, she meets another mysterious boy in the woods…
translation: 埃莉诺喜欢她父亲给她讲的故事。尤其是关于银狐的那一集。然而，这不是一个故事。她知道这是真的；她知道这是真的。神秘动物存在！为了证明父亲一直都是对的，她亲自寻找银狐。她和住在奶牛场的最好的朋友杰克一起，不断探索森林。然而有一天，她在树林里遇到了另一位神秘男孩……
